verdict.rationale: Granola documents user-controlled transcript auto-deletion with selectable retention periods (1 day to 1 year), plus permanent deletion and restore of meeting notes, so users control both retention and deletion. Auto-deletion covers transcripts only; notes are explicitly unaffected. Missing for 10: automatic retention policies for notes and summaries, documented account-level or programmatic (API) deletion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Granola allows you to automatically delete transcripts after a set period of time.
Choose a retention period from the dropdown: 1 day, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, 6 months, or 1 year
Delete or restore Granola meeting notes. Permanently remove notes or recover accidentally deleted ones.
This applies only to transcripts — your notes are not affected and will remain available.
